title: CFA Institute Research Challenge Presentation Scoring Sheet

criteria.name: Financial Analysis
criteria.official_prompt: How thorough was their analysis of the industry, company, and competitors?

criteria.name: Valuation
criteria.official_prompt: Were the valuation methodologies appropriate and detailed?

criteria.name: Environmental, Social, and Governance
criteria.official_prompt: Did the analysis thoroughly incorporate conservation of the natural world, consideration of people and relationships, and standards for running a company?

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.official_prompt: How effective/convincing was their presentation? Was it logical and did the facts support the recommendation?

criteria.name: Question & Answer
criteria.official_prompt: Were they able to answer the questions effectively and with confidence?

criteria.name: Team Involvement
criteria.official_prompt: Team involvement in the presentation/questions and answers

sources.title: CFA Institute Research Challenge Official Rules 2026-2027
sources.evidence: Appendix E publishes the seven criteria, prompts, maximum scores, and 100-point total.

provenance.applicability_note: Used for local, regional semifinal, regional, and global presentations in the cited rules edition. Sub-regional scoring differs because Question & Answer is omitted.
